title: (Pwn2Own) Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 charx-system-config-manager Service CRLF Injection Firewall Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass firewall rules on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the charx-system-config-manager service. The issue results from incorrect neutralization of CRLF sequences. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of the user-app user.
